scenes.summary: Perlica tells you about the past.

lines.text: Here is a brief recap of what has happened so far, Endministrator. Nefarith tore apart the Æther rift of Valley IV, leaving the UWST in urgent need of our assistance. We decided to set off immediately.
Our plan was to escort a prototype named "Tata" to the Æther Test Site and seal the Æther rift. However, the direct route to the Power Plateau was cut off.
We were forced to take a detour through the Originium Science Park. There, we met Yvonne, the prototype's designer and a research prodigy. She helped us repair Tata.
We also met Rossi from the Pack at the Origin Lodespring. Both she and Wulfgard covered our advance into the Cradle of the Ages.
Despite our efforts, both the Ankhor and Aggeloi continued to press us. The path through the mines was blanketed in a shroud of deathly red light.
The Triaggelos rose again in the Cradle of the Ages. We defeated this powerful enemy after a difficult battle and opened the way to the Power Plateau.
The surviving crew mates of the Power Plateau never gave up. Professor Crowe activated the "Utjug Order" that brought down the fury of the United Syndicates.
Endfield was not alone. Our allies helped us reach the arena of the final confrontation.
Nefarith, the leader of the Bonekrushers, proved far more dangerous than we thought. She summoned a humanoid Aggelos called the Marble Aggelomoirai to stop us from sealing the rift.
With great difficulty, we defeated the Marble Aggelomoirai, but Nefarith exploited an opening and suddenly launched her own attack...
Your ignored your own survival and tried to unleash an Originium Arts burst to stop her... Fortunately, the suppressor activated in the nick of time and prevented your self-destruction.
Nefarith and those behind her had schemed to sow the seeds of chaos. While you, Endministrator ... have always been pushing yourself too hard...
The rift fully opened, and the Valley faced inevitable annihilation. In the final moments, Tata sacrificed itself to neutralize the rift and saved everyone.
But a new crisis is emerging... Nefarith has been sighted at Wuling and she is poised to strike at the Very Large Rift. We must stop her!
